spellbook.finance/limitations: The CSV text passes through your model context, so a large file costs tokens on the way in. A file over 200,000 characters is refused here; the person imports it through the SpellBook web app instead.

Mapped labels retain case, punctuation, Unicode and leading zeros; only surrounding whitespace is trimmed. A label may contain at most 64 characters and no control characters. An import accepts at most 5,000 distinct source locations; split a file with more destinations into separate imports. Invalid labels or ambiguous automatic column detection refuse the whole import before writes.

Source locations are additive destinations: importing adds new copies there and leaves existing copies unchanged. A location label does not prove the cards are physically present. Report returned binAssignments without inventing storage hierarchy or moving cards.

Missing locations are assigned by the server using binPrefix unless blankLocation is error. oneBinPerUpload or binName cannot combine with mapped locations. Set locationColumn to none to ignore file locations and use upload-wide allocation.
Every entry in parseErrors and skippedRows is a row this call did not import, with its CSV line number and the reason. Report each one to the person. itemsWritten counts only what was imported.
totalCost is split equally across every copy in the file. Omitting it records zero cost. Never guess a cost; ask the person or leave it out and say the cost is unrecorded.

A TCGplayer export records its copies as listed, because TCGplayer already sells them. spellbook_ebay_publish takes owned copies only, so it will not publish those. A ManaBox export records copies as owned.

For Pokémon and Riftbound, exact catalog identity is required before a physical copy is written: game, namespaced product identity, provider SKU, finish, condition, and language must agree. A skipped row is repairable catalog coverage, not proof of zero stock.

A TCGplayer marketplace baseline is separate from physical inventory. Use the SpellBook web seller-activation flow to inspect baseline rows and confirm exact physical stock; this tool does not turn baseline quantity into owned stock.

Sending the same CSV text again returns the first import's result with duplicate true and writes nothing, even if locationColumn or blankLocation changes. Changing even one character makes a new import, so do not retry with an edited file unless the person wants a second import.
This tool cannot undo or edit an import. A person deletes a whole import in the SpellBook web app.
spellbook_ebay_publish and the ManaPool sync tools accept copies imported here, the same as copies recorded through spellbook_inventory_bin_ensure.
Workspace membership is backend-enforced. This writes to the workspace you name and to no other.

The free Seller cap counts only copies listed on a marketplace. A ManaBox import lands owned and is never refused for the cap. A TCGplayer import lands listed, so it can return `free_seller_card_cap_exceeded`, and then the whole import was refused and wrote nothing. Offer a smaller import, or selling or removing listed copies to make room.

Recovery scope is workspace; observedAt timestamps the observation, not later state. cap is the allowance. countIsExact applies to activeUnitCount; false means a lower bound. headroom is admission capacity after reservations, clamped at zero. rowsFit counts requested physical units that fit. Inventory reads and order fulfillment remain available. This says nothing about automation or payment.

annotations.title: Import a ManaBox or TCGplayer CSV

description: Import a seller's own ManaBox export or TCGplayer inventory export into one workspace, the same import the SpellBook Finance web app runs. The server parses the CSV, resolves each row to an exact printing, preserves mapped location labels or assigns fallback bins, and creates one inventory copy per card. TCGplayer Pokémon and Riftbound rows require the catalog's exact game, provider product identity, finish, condition, and language; incomplete or mismatched rows are skipped with a repair reason and never default to Magic, English, or nonfoil. Sending the identical CSV again returns the first result with duplicate true and creates nothing. Returns the importId, how many copies were written, the bins used, and every row it could not parse or skipped.

binName.description: A human name for that one bin, 1 to 48 letters, digits, spaces, dashes or underscores. Honored only when oneBinPerUpload is true. A name another import already holds is refused.

binPrefix.description: One capital letter that starts fallback bin codes for copies without a mapped location, e.g. C gives C0001, C0002. Defaults to C.

blankLocation.description: For a blank cell in a selected location column: generate assigns a fallback bin; error refuses the whole import before writing copies. Defaults to generate. Has no effect without a selected column.

csv.description: The full CSV text, header row included, exactly as the export produced it. Required. At most 200,000 characters.

locationColumn.description: Location column: auto detects a single common location or bin header, none ignores source locations, or a zero-based original CSV column index selects it explicitly. Defaults to auto. Multiple matching headers require an explicit choice.

oneBinPerUpload.description: True puts the whole file in one fresh bin instead of packing 200 cards per bin across the rolling sequence. Defaults to false. Refused when any imported row has a mapped location.

source.description: Which export this is: manabox for a ManaBox CSV (needs Scryfall ID, Quantity, Condition and Foil columns), tcg for a TCGplayer seller inventory export (needs the TCGplayer Id column). Required.

totalCost.description: What the seller paid for the whole file in USD, split equally across every copy. Omit when the seller has not stated it; omitting records zero cost.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to import into. Required; writes only to this workspace.
